chapter: King Oliver, own trio and Kirby
title: Playing in Kirby's first band at the Onyx Club
summary: About two years at the Onyx, Kirby listened to sidemen, would not allow sit-ins, rehearsed, and played from memory calling keys.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: All right. So when Kirby came in and he liked the trio, and brought you into what became the first John Kirby group...
Yes.
...a seven-piece group. And you played at the Onyx. Now, how long did you play with Kirby?
I worked down there almost two years.
About two years. Now, following you as a drummer was O'Neil Spencer.
Moore (II) - 42
O'Neil Spencer. Different band altogether.
How did you like playing with Kirby?
Mmm, he was all right.
How was he to get along with?

He's the type of person to listen what the fellas...listen to the boys in the band. See? Like, if the drummer played something with the saxophone player, and it sounded good to him, and backed it up, he wanted the same thing back the other guy...he wanted the same thing behind him. Like a trumpet player. He wanted the same thing behind him, you know. Everything he had... If one of the horn blowers, players rather, didn't go over so good, he put it on the drummer. The drummer's always got to back them other guys up, you know. Sometimes someone will want a snare drum, a press roll, and some want the hi-hat, some want the ride cymbal.
Were there musicians who would sit in at the Onyx Club with Kirby's group? Was he receptive to musicians sitting in, or was it the sextet...?
No, he didn't allow them to sit in.
So he had a pre-set arrangement as to how he wanted his band to sound.
Yes.
Did he rehearse a great deal.
Moore (II) - 43
We had to do a lot of rehearsing.
Okay. And he rehearsed with sheet music.
Yes.
But did he use sheet music at the Onyx?
No.
He didn't. Okay...
You always come to remember... You see, you remember different numbers...
Commit it to memory.
And just call the keys out.
I see.
Call the name and the keys.
